summary: Nginx Proxy Manager is a containerised tool that provides a graphical user interface for configuring Nginx proxy hosts. It simplifies the setup of routing web traffic without requiring direct editing of text-based server block configurations.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to manage reverse proxies and TLS termination through a web dashboard rather than the command line.
watchOut: It abstracts away the underlying configuration files, which can make advanced customisations or debugging more difficult if you encounter edge cases.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a container, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for your configuration and certificate data to survive container restarts.
